$doc: Vyomi capability registry — CloudFormation. One entry per console section; level per substrate (nano = shared core, also dev_server/unified ingress; offline = appliance). Proven by tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py — a claim the backend does not honour fails CI.

aws.cloudformation.resource-provisioning.title: Template resources provisioned through the real S3 / DynamoDB / SNS / SQS / IAM / CloudWatch Logs engines
limitations: Only AWS::S3::Bucket, AWS::DynamoDB::Table, AWS::SNS::Topic, AWS::SQS::Queue, AWS::IAM::Role, AWS::Logs::LogGroup and the no-infrastructure AWS::CloudFormation::WaitCondition[Handle] are provisioned.
A template with any other resource type fails CreateStack/UpdateStack honestly (rolled back, never a silent success) — the same way a real account without the matching service permissions would fail.

aws.cloudformation.stack.outputs-exports.title: Outputs and cross-stack exports (global export-name uniqueness enforced)

aws.cloudformation.stack.template.title: Template body, JSON and a YAML subset (short-form !Ref/!GetAtt/!Sub/!Join/!If/…, long-form Fn:: mappings), intrinsic function resolution
limitations: The YAML parser covers block mappings/sequences and single-line short-form tags; multi-line short-form tag arguments are not supported (use the JSON or long-form Fn:: syntax instead).

aws.cloudformation.stack.changesets.title: Change sets (create, describe with Add/Remove/Modify diff, execute, delete, list)

aws.cloudformation.stack.drift.title: Drift detection
limitations: Beyond existence (a resource deleted independently shows as DELETED), PROPERTY-level drift is enforced for DynamoDB (BillingMode, ProvisionedThroughput), SNS (DisplayName, FifoTopic), SQS (VisibilityTimeout, MessageRetentionPeriod, FifoQueue, ContentBasedDeduplication), IAM roles (AssumeRolePolicyDocument, Description, Path) and Logs log groups (RetentionInDays): each property is re-read from the owning service's own store and diffed against the value CloudFormation last applied, reported as MODIFIED with concrete PropertyDifferences.

S3 buckets have no provisioner-managed mutable property in this simulation (Vyomi's S3 bucket provisioning doesn't apply VersioningConfiguration or other template properties), so they remain existence-only drift.

aws.cloudformation.stack.rollback-protec.title: Rollback on failure, ContinueUpdateRollback, termination protection

aws.cloudformation.stacksets.title: StackSets (create, describe, list, delete)
limitations: Control plane only — a StackSet's own template/parameters are stored, but Vyomi does not deploy stack instances across accounts or Regions (ListStackInstances always returns empty).

aws.cloudformation.stack-refactors.title: Stack refactors
limitations: A refactor moves a resource's runtime state (ref, physical id, properties) between two EXISTING stacks — it does not create new stacks from StackDefinitions, the way the real ListStackRefactorActions / template-diff flow does.

aws.cloudformation.registry.activated-ex.title: Activated extensions (the resource types this CloudFormation engine actually supports)

aws.cloudformation.registry.public-exten.title: Public extensions registry and publisher registration
limitations: The third-party extension marketplace and publisher workflow are out of Vyomi's scope.

aws.cloudformation.hooks.title: Hooks (register, configure, invoke on stack operations, invocation history)
limitations: A hook's policy is a single built-in check — required tag keys that must be present on every stack it targets — not arbitrary custom hook handler code (which would run a third-party Lambda or script in a real account).
ListHookResults returns every invocation in the account when no TargetId is given; real AWS scopes results to one stack or change set at a time.

aws.cloudformation.iac-generator.title: IaC generator (scan an account's existing resources into a template)
limitations: StartResourceScan really scans the live S3/DynamoDB/SNS/SQS/IAM/Logs stores — the same six resource types CreateStack/UpdateStack provision — and CreateGeneratedTemplate builds a real template from each selected resource's live properties (re-read through the owning service's own store, the same way drift detection does), so GetGeneratedTemplate's output imports cleanly through CreateStack.
Real AWS scans the whole account through Resource Explorer across every resource type; Vyomi's scan only covers the six resource types the CloudFormation simulation provisions.

aws.cloudformation.template-studio.title: Template studio editor (YAML/JSON, Validate)
limitations: The template + text editing and Validate action are real; the visual resource Canvas view is not simulated.

aws.cloudformation.spotlight.title: CloudFormation Spotlight (editorial content)
limitations: Spotlight is an editorial content feed, not an API surface — out of Vyomi's scope.
